info.longName: Invesco BulletShares 2032 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF

funds_data.description: The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, “effective maturities” in the year 2032. The fund is non-diversified.
